{{Quote|You have entered CorSec controlled space. Please identify yourself.|CorSec Outpost hailing a ship|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
The '''CorSec Outpost''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] operated by the [[Corellian Security Force]] near [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].

[[Merchant/Legends|Traders]] of the [[Miners Alliance]] aboard the station bought [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] resources from independent space [[Mining/Legends|miners]].

==Behind the scenes==
The CorSec Outpost is a space station in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', located in the Corellian system. When the game's second add-on, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] was released, it added the ability to [[:w:c:swg:Space mining|mine asteroids]] for various resources. The developers also added [[:w:c:swg:Space mining#Mining Stations|Mining Stations]] to most of the game's star systems to provide the players with an easy way of selling these resources for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. Only few players however sell asteroid resources to such stations, as the prices paid by other players are significantly higher.

The station cannot be entered and when hailed only gives the option to sell asteroid resources.
